messages.author: cf28faff6c393440
messages.subject: updateSelectInput in shiny 0.9
parts:
I would like to dynamically update a select input in shiny. This was working in 0.8 but seems to not work anymore in 0.9. I have a text input whose input I would like to use for a choice label in my select input. For testing, I realised another text input, that successfully shows the value of the first one. However this does not seem to work for the select:

ui.r:
shinyUI(bootstrapPage(
       
        selectInput("inselect","my select",""),
        textInput("intext","my intext:",""),
        textInput("outtext","my outtext:","")
   
    ))

server.r:
shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {
       
        observe({
               
                x=input$intext
               
                s=1;names(s)=x
                updateSelectInput(session,"inselect",choices=s,selected=1)
                updateTextInput(session,"outtext",value=x)
               
            })
    })


any help would be highly appreciated.

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: updateSelectInput in shiny 0.9
parts:
Hi Michael - It looks like you're running into a bug with updateSelectInput. I've filed an issue here:
https://github.com/rstudio/shiny/issues/428

For now, I suggest using the old style select input, by calling selectInput(..., selectize=FALSE).

-Winston
